title: Microsoft Purview Data Security Investigations: personal data examination
summary: Hold: the briefing overstates access by saying anyone in the three role groups can examine the personal data, without accounting for investigation membership. It also presents file count as a proportional compute billing rule that Microsoft does not publish; the roadmap facts and the listed paths and commands are supported.

claims.claim: DSI is a Microsoft Purview solution for analysing content associated with data security incidents.
claims.quote: This addition works alongside DSI’s AI-powered content analysis features, such as categorization, AI search, and examination for risk, which help surface data security risks buried in data.

claims.claim: Personal data works alongside Credentials, Risk, Mitigation and Custom examination focus areas.
claims.quote: You can choose examination processing for the following focus areas: Credentials; Risks; Mitigation; Personal data; Custom.

claims.claim: Within a selected investigation, open Analysis, select items, select Examine and choose Personal data in Choose a focus area.
claims.quote: Select an investigation, and then select Analysis on the navigation bar. Select one or more items, and then select Examine on the command bar.

claims.quote: Select Settings in the upper-right corner of the page, then select Role groups in the left navigation. Select one of the Data Security Investigations role groups, then select Edit. Select Choose users

claims.quote: Microsoft recommends having compute units and AI processing done anywhere with available GPU capacity.

claims.claim: DSI's licensing model is consumption.

claims.quote: Billing in Data Security Investigations is based solely on the combination of the amount of stored data and the associated computing capacity needed for AI analysis. It isn't based on a dedicated enterprise plan or license.

claims.where: Governance guidance: At rollout; rationale: cost
claims.claim: Each personal data examination consumes compute units in proportion to the number of files analysed.
claims.quote: Searched: Data Security Investigations personal data examination compute unit price rate focus area. Read billing and AI-analysis: file count is a cost variable, while data size and examination options also influence compute; no proportional per-file rule.
claims.fix: Replace 'each personal data examination consumes compute units in proportion to the files analysed' with 'each personal data examination consumes compute units; the billing page lists the number of files analysed as a cost variable'. The cited billing page supports these narrower statements: https://learn.microsoft.com/purview/data-security-investigations-billing.
